verdict.line: You lose if you walk Garen into a silenced trade or over-extend near his level 6 R, you win if you land E first and keep him tethered as a Vessel.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) directly answers Garen's Perseverance — the spirit tether and resulting Vessel keep him 'recently struck' so his passive regen never ticks, while every follow-up hit echoes back onto him. The measured 45.9% win rate over 37 games says this is close despite Illaoi's structural lane and solo-kill edge, because Garen's Q silence and level-6 execute threat punish sloppy all-ins.

theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike (8s cooldown) breaks any slow on him and silences you on his next auto — if it's available, don't open your E/W all-in into it, bait it out on a minion or tentacle first.

yourWindow.when: The instant you land E on him
yourWindow.what: Immediately follow with W and Q — the spirit echoes a percentage of that damage straight back onto Garen, and if he can't kill the spirit or disengage far enough he becomes a Vessel, locking out his Perseverance sustain entirely.

start.why: The highest-sample start (40% WR over 30 games, 60% pick) — the lifesteal keeps you healthy through repeated Harsh Lesson and tentacle trades instead of trading evenly and losing the HP race.

boots.why: Far more picked (69.6%) and mitigates the auto-attack and Judgment spin damage Garen leans on in extended trades.

core.why: The highest-winning core path (40% WR) — the proc adds AoE and a slow so your tentacle trades land cleanly instead of letting Garen Q away.
Stacking armor shred matters against a bruiser with no armor scaling of his own, keeping your Q/W/tentacle damage relevant into the late game.
The health and damage lock-in buys you the HP buffer to survive Demacian Justice's missing-health execute instead of dying to it outright.

situational.when: the enemy team is stacking magic damage and you need the extra healing from tentacle procs
you're getting burst down in skirmishes before your tentacles have time to heal you back
you're snowballing lane and want an earlier damage/sustain spike instead of the full tank path

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-winning page (65% WR, 40.8% pick) — Grasp's max-health proc and heal reward the repeated W dashes and tentacle-assisted trades this matchup is built around, offsetting Garen's own Perseverance sustain.

summoners.why: The highest-sample pairing (56.5% WR, 46.9% pick) — Teleport lets you reset after a Vessel all-in or match his wave pressure; Exhaust+Flash (28.6% pick) is the safer swap if you're worried about getting caught by his level 6 execute.

playing.title: Open every trade with E
playing.detail: Test of Spirit should be your first action in any extended trade — it tethers Garen's spirit so your follow-up damage echoes back onto him, and if he can't kill the spirit or disengage far enough he becomes a Vessel.

playing.title: Bait Q before you all-in
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence on his empowered auto can shut your E/W mid-cast — wait for him to use it on a minion or hold your all-in until it's down.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-8 execute
playing.detail: Demacian Justice scales off missing health — don't extend a trade below roughly a third of your HP once Garen hits level 6.

playing.title: Spam W near terrain tentacles
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson's 4s cooldown and the extra tentacle swings it triggers make it your best sustained-trade tool — stay near your passive's terrain spawns to stack the free damage.

playing.title: Punish his Judgment cooldown
playing.detail: Garen's E drops to 9s at max rank and is his main poke and clear tool — step up and trade freely the moment you see it go down.

playing.title: Stay on a Vessel, don't let him walk off
playing.detail: Once Garen is tethered, stay in range so tentacle procs keep landing — if he escapes the tether range the Vessel effect ends and his Perseverance can reset.

playing.title: Hold R for skirmishes, not 1v1 openers
playing.detail: Leap of Faith's long cooldown (120/95/70/70/70s) makes it too valuable to burn as a lane opener — save it to spawn extra tentacles if the fight goes to 2v2 or a gank.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the quoted win rates/pick rates are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade timing, cooldown reads, and matchup reasoning are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Garen will try to fall back after engaging to restore health back up with his (P), so use [Q] or [E] to either deactivate (P) or nuke him for a kill. Garen will try to get a kill with (R) after reaching level 6, so be careful when your health is low.
